services.name: rassyclaw
command: set -eu; cfg(){ openclaw config set "$1" "$2" --strict-json >/dev/null; }; if [ -n "${APP_LOCAL_DOMAIN:-}" ]; then ALLOWED_ORIGINS="[\"${APP_PROTOCOL:-http}://${APP_DOMAIN}\",\"${APP_PROTOCOL:-http}://${APP_LOCAL_DOMAIN}\"]"; else ALLOWED_ORIGINS="[\"${APP_PROTOCOL:-http}://${APP_DOMAIN}\"]"; fi; if [ -n "${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF:-}" ]; then FALLBACKS="[\"${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF}\"]"; else FALLBACKS="[]"; fi; TRUSTED_PROXIES_JSON="$(node -e 'const list=(process.argv[1]||"").split(",").map((value)=>value.trim()).filter(Boolean); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(list));' "${OPENCLAW_TRUSTED_PROXIES:-}")"; MODELS_JSON="$(node -e 'const refs=process.argv.slice(1).map((value)=>String(value||"").trim()).filter(Boolean); const out={}; for (const ref of refs) out[ref]={params:{maxTokens:512}}; process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(out));' "${OPENCLAW_PRIMARY_MODEL_REF:-}" "${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF:-}")"; TOOLS_BY_PROVIDER_JSON="$(node -e 'const refs=process.argv.slice(1).map((value)=>String(value||"").trim()).filter(Boolean); const out={}; for (const ref of refs) out[ref]={profile:"minimal"}; process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(out));' "${OPENCLAW_PRIMARY_MODEL_REF:-}" "${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF:-}")"; cfg gateway "{\"mode\":\"local\",\"bind\":\"lan\",\"port\":18789,\"auth\":{\"mode\":\"token\",\"token\":\"${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN}\"},\"controlUi\":{\"enabled\":true,\"basePath\":\"/rassyclaw\",\"allowedOrigins\":$$ALLOWED_ORIGINS},\"trustedProxies\":$$TRUSTED_PROXIES_JSON,\"http\":{\"endpoints\":{\"chatCompletions\":{\"enabled\":true},\"responses\":{\"enabled\":true}}}}"; cfg models "{\"mode\":\"merge\",\"providers\":{\"ollama\":{\"baseUrl\":\"http://ollama-proxy:11436\",\"api\":\"ollama\",\"apiKey\":\"${OLLAMA_API_KEY}\",\"models\":[]}}}"; cfg agents.defaults.model "{\"primary\":\"${OPENCLAW_PRIMARY_MODEL_REF}\",\"fallbacks\":$$FALLBACKS}"; cfg agents.list "[{\"id\":\"main\",\"model\":\"${OPENCLAW_PRIMARY_MODEL_REF}\"}]"; cfg agents.defaults.models "{}"; cfg agents.defaults.models "$$MODELS_JSON"; cfg tools.byProvider "{}"; cfg tools.byProvider "$$TOOLS_BY_PROVIDER_JSON"; cfg agents.defaults.memorySearch "{\"provider\":\"ollama\",\"model\":\"${OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL}\",\"fallback\":\"none\"}"; exec openclaw gateway run --allow-unconfigured --bind lan --port 18789
